tasks.short: Calculate energy savings against baseline standards.

steps.what: Load estimated consumption for the proposed design.
Calculate potential energy savings against baseline standards.
Check by comparing the result with the design.
Release the energy result the architect checked.

tasks.design: Estimated consumption for the proposed design loads only when the inputs are already fields. Potential energy savings against the baseline standards are calculated in the attested calculation, not by a draft. The architect checks the result against the design. {PROJECT} releases that checked result. A model may explain the result and must not compute it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The comparison was retyped into a sheet, and a changed design kept the old figure.
tasks.enabler_now: Inputs that are fields, and a baseline, are a calculation.
tasks.still_hard: An input the design does not support, or a result that cannot be explained, stays a check. The figure is not adjusted by hand to look better.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which input the design does not actually have.

ambition.what: A design change can rerun the attested calculation the same week, and an unchecked figure is not released.

tasks.altitude: The arithmetic takes less retyping. The check stays. Unstructured inputs are not calculated, and a draft does not produce the figure.

evidence.claim: Comparing field inputs with a baseline is a calculation. The source pack says a model may explain an energy result and must not compute it. This is the pattern, not a measured case here.

The source pack names a Dutch rule that new-building energy figures come from attested software and a qualified person. Other countries differ. This release is the architect's check, not a certificate by itself.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect runs the attested calculation and checks it. Certification of the building is a different task. A language model does not compute the figure.
Structured input: design id, consumption field, baseline id. Producer is the design model for the inputs. A missing field stops the calculation. The result is not edited to force a saving.
The check is remaining time. An unexplained result is not released.
unknowns: Who is allowed to release an energy figure?
research_questions: How often does a design change leave the old energy figure in the report?

already_counted.description: Checking the result is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire results when the design inputs change.

approvals.approved_version: result the architect checked for that design

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the inputs are not fields, nothing is calculated and the architect still has to assemble them. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Energy savings are calculated from stored fields in attested software. A draft does not compute the figure, and an unchecked result is not released.
reach: Only a checked energy result is released to the design file.
skills_to_grow: Stop the calculation when a required input is missing.
Do not let a model replace the attested figure.
role.ambitious_version: A design change reruns the energy calculation the same week, and the old figure does not stay in the report.
